result.instructions: Tools for Mercoa, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mercoa data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run mercoa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mercoa_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mercoa_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. mercoa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mercoa_find_entities
tools.title: Find entities
tools.description: Find/search entities (buyers, vendors, payors, payees). Use to look up counterparties by name/email/foreignId or list all. GET /entity.

search.description: Search by name, email, emailTo, entity ID, or foreign ID (partial matches).

isCustomer.description: If true, only entities with a direct relationship to your organization.

foreignId.description: Your system's ID(s) for the entity.

paymentMethods.description: If true, include payment methods in the response.

returnMetadata.description: Metadata key(s) to include in the response.

tools.name: mercoa_get_entity
tools.title: Get entity
tools.description: Get a single entity by ID (or foreign ID). GET /entity/{entityId}.

entityId.description: Entity ID (e.g. ent_...) or foreign ID.

tools.name: mercoa_get_entity_events
tools.title: Get entity events
tools.description: Get the event/audit log for an entity. GET /entity/{entityId}/events.

tools.name: mercoa_get_entity_invoice_metrics
tools.title: Get entity invoice metrics
tools.description: Get aggregate invoice metrics (totals/counts, grouped by currency) for an entity's payables/receivables — for AP/AR dashboards and aging. GET /entity/{entityId}/invoice-metrics.

search.description: Search by vendor name, invoice number, check number, or amount.

returnByDate.description: Group metrics by date, e.g. CREATION_DATE or DUE_DATE.

returnByDateFrequency.description: Frequency for date grouping (e.g. DAILY, MONTHLY).

approverId.description: Filter by assigned approver user ID(s).

invoiceId.description: Filter by invoice ID(s) or foreign ID(s).

status.description: Invoice status filter (e.g. NEW, SCHEDULED, PAID).

dateType.description: Date type to filter by (e.g. CREATED_AT, DUE_DATE).

currency.description: Currency code(s) to filter on, e.g. USD.

tools.name: mercoa_list_entity_payment_methods
tools.title: List entity payment methods
tools.description: List an entity's payment methods (bank accounts, cards, check, etc.). GET /entity/{entityId}/paymentMethods.

type.description: Filter by payment method type (e.g. bankAccount, card, check).

tools.name: mercoa_get_payment_method
tools.title: Get payment method
tools.description: Get a single payment method for an entity. GET /entity/{entityId}/paymentMethod/{paymentMethodId}.

tools.name: mercoa_list_entity_users
tools.title: List entity users
tools.description: List the users belonging to an entity (approvers, admins, etc.). GET /entity/{entityId}/users.

tools.name: mercoa_find_invoices
tools.title: Find invoices
tools.description: Find/search invoices (bills) across payers and vendors. Filter by status, entity, date, approver and more. GET /invoices (plural list endpoint).

entityId.description: Filter by entity (payer or vendor) ID(s) or foreign ID(s).

status.description: Invoice status filter (e.g. DRAFT, NEW, APPROVED, SCHEDULED, PAID).

payerId.description: Filter by payer ID(s) or foreign ID(s).

vendorId.description: Filter by vendor ID(s) or foreign ID(s).

invoiceId.description: Filter by invoice ID(s) or foreign ID(s).

search.description: Search by vendor name, invoice number, check number, or amount.

dateType.description: Date type to filter by (e.g. CREATED_AT, DUE_DATE).

orderBy.description: Field to order by (e.g. CREATED_AT, AMOUNT, DUE_DATE).

approverId.description: Filter by assigned approver user ID(s).

approverAction.description: Filter by approver action (use with approverId), e.g. APPROVE.

creatorUserId.description: Filter by the user ID(s) that created the invoice.

returnPayerMetadata.description: Include payer metadata in the response.

returnVendorMetadata.description: Include vendor metadata in the response.

returnPaymentTiming.description: Include payment timing in the response.

tools.name: mercoa_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get a single invoice (bill) by ID. GET /invoice/{invoiceId}.

invoiceId.description: Invoice ID (e.g. in_...) or foreign ID.

tools.name: mercoa_get_invoice_events
tools.title: Get invoice events
tools.description: Get the event/audit log for an invoice (status changes, approvals, payments). GET /invoice/{invoiceId}/events.

tools.name: mercoa_find_transactions
tools.title: Find transactions
tools.description: List/search payment transactions. Filter by entity, invoice, status, type and date. GET /transactions.

entityId.description: Filter by entity ID(s) or foreign ID(s).

invoiceId.description: Filter by invoice ID(s) or foreign ID(s).

search.description: Search by vendor name, invoice number, check number, or amount.

tools.name: mercoa_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: Get a single payment transaction by ID. GET /transaction/{transactionId}.

tools.name: mercoa_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Get the caller's Mercoa organization configuration (settings, payment methods enabled, etc.). GET /organization.

tools.name: mercoa_create_entity
tools.title: Create entity
tools.description: WRITE — creates a real entity (customer/vendor/payor/payee) in Mercoa. Supply role flags, accountType, and a nested `profile` object (business or individual details). POST /entity.

isCustomer.description: Whether this entity has a direct relationship with your organization.

isPayor.description: Whether this entity can pay invoices (AP).

isPayee.description: Whether this entity can receive payments (AR / vendor).

foreignId.description: Your system's ID for this entity.

profile.description: Nested profile object, e.g. { "business": { "legalBusinessName": "Acme Inc.", "email": "ap@acme.com", "businessType": "llc" } } or { "individual": { "name": {...}, "email": "..." } }.

tools.name: mercoa_create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: WRITE — creates a real invoice/bill in Mercoa. Set status (DRAFT to stage, NEW to submit), amount, currency, payer/vendor, dates and line items. POST /invoice.

status.description: Invoice status, e.g. DRAFT, NEW, APPROVED, SCHEDULED.

creatorEntityId.description: Entity ID on whose behalf the invoice is created.

paymentSourceId.description: Payment method ID to pay from (payer's).

paymentDestinationId.description: Payment method ID to pay to (vendor's).

tools.name: mercoa_update_invoice
tools.title: Update invoice
tools.description: WRITE — updates an existing invoice/bill (all fields optional). Commonly used to advance status (e.g. DRAFT→NEW→SCHEDULED) or change amounts, dates, or payment methods. POST /invoice/{invoiceId}.

status.description: New invoice status, e.g. NEW, APPROVED, SCHEDULED.

paymentSourceId.description: Payment method ID to pay from.

paymentDestinationId.description: Payment method ID to pay to.

tools.name: mercoa_add_invoice_comment
tools.title: Add invoice comment
tools.description: WRITE — adds a comment to an invoice (visible in its activity log). POST /invoice/{invoiceId}/comment.

userId.description: ID or foreign ID of the user creating the comment.
